_about: Headless-wake allowlist (REMOVE-THE-GO; ratified RATIFICATION-WAKE-CADENCE 2026-08-18). Replaces --dangerously-skip-permissions in scripts/wake.ps1. Deny-by-default is the fence: in print mode an unanswerable permission prompt is a denial, so any tool call not matching a rule below fails closed and the seat reports BLOCKED instead of acting. MCP tools, WebFetch/WebSearch, gh beyond the two rules here, and all other shell commands are therefore unavailable to a headless wake. Widening this list is an allow-list widening — founder-ratified, never a seat's own act.
